topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the core themes of cancer evolution, and presents the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Mechanisms in Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications confer competitive growth advantages that drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the role of tissue differentiation hierarchies and stemness capacity in cancer initiation and propagation across different tissue types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Drivers of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how environmental promoters, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal cells create permissive conditions for tumor outgrowth and progression.

topics.label: Methodologies for Investigating Cancer Heterogeneity and Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the genomic, transcriptomic, and spatial profiling technologies used to study tumor evolution and cell interactions in laboratory research.

topics.label: Integrated Conceptual Model of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary model of cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding sign-off for the session and previews the subsequent lecture on therapy.
